entities.name: Averru
entities.description: One of the ancient Numena of Dominaria, who made a spell to resurrect himself as a giant city, later called Sanctum.

entities.name: Numena
entities.description: Ancient beings on the plane of Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Numena ruled.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: Ancient golden stone city on a cliff in the Corian Escarpment, which is Averru reborn as a city.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: The red Primeval, a dragon trapped by Averru beneath a caldera in Shiv.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Rhammidarigaaz was trapped under a caldera.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: One of the three remaining Numena, killed in Karona's War.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: One of the three remaining Numena, who suffocated trapped in stone.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Goddess whose birth caused the Fall of the Numena and who killed Averru in Karona's War.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: Named the city Sanctum and welcomed settlers; used as Averru's spiritual Mother.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: Rediscovered the city with Zagorka and later helped free Lowallyn.

entities.name: Elionoway
entities.description: Elf settler of Sanctum who could read the runes foretelling the return of the three brothers.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Arrived during the battle between Akroma and Phage, triggering the rebirth of Karona.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: The Mother in essence of Lowallyn.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: The Mother in body of Kuberr.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: War after which Sanctum was rediscovered.

entities.name: Fall of the Numena
entities.description: Event caused by the birth of Karona.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: War in which Averru and the other Numena tried to destroy Karona.

events.summary: During the Fall of the Primevals, Averru traps the red Primeval Rhammidarigaaz beneath a caldera in Shiv and gains the dragon's powers.
events.quote: Averru trapped the red Primeval Rhammidarigaaz beneath a caldera in Shiv

events.summary: Averru takes part in killing the white and green Numena, leaving only himself, Lowallyn and Kuberr.
events.quote: Averru participated in killing the white and the green Numena

events.summary: After the birth of Karona ends the Numena's rule, Averru creates a spell to resurrect himself as a giant city.
events.quote: Averru created a spell to resurrect himself as a giant city

events.summary: Stonebrow and Zagorka rediscover the city after the Nightmare War; Zagorka names it Sanctum and welcomes settlers.
Kamahl's arrival during the battle between Akroma and Phage disrupts Averru's plans by triggering the rebirth of Karona.
events.quote: disrupted Averru's plans by triggering the Rebirth of Karona

events.summary: Karona encases the Numena in stone; Kuberr suffocates and Lowallyn is freed, then stomped to death by his own magma giant under Karona's control.
events.quote: Kuberr was left trapped inside too long and suffocated

events.summary: Karona blasts Averru with pure magic, destroying him and the city; the last numen dies.
events.quote: The city was destroyed, and the god with it.

relations.quote: Averru was one of the Numena
Averru trapped the red Primeval Rhammidarigaaz beneath a caldera in Shiv
Karona to blast Averru with pure magic
stomping Lowallyn to death with his massive burning foot

relations.note: Sanctum is Averru reborn as a city
relations.quote: As Sanctum , Averru was an ancient city
